flags.wound.echo: Ellis feels the wound without yet having the two sentences.
flags.era.E0: The 1952 season is the one being lived. Set by the era seam, not by a quest.

flags.era.E2: The 1980 season is the one being lived.
flags.era.E3: The 1994 season is the one being lived.
flags.era.E4: The 2008 season is the one being lived.
flags.era.E5: The 2022 season is the one being lived.
flags.orchard.truth_told: Maeve was told Ivo moved the stake. The south block is named as Harrow silt, not county timber.
flags.orchard.stake_hidden: The stake was driven deeper and the county line left looking honest.
flags.orchard.unresolved: The orchard chain broke on Ellis's death or refusal before a choice. Maeve has a rumor and no sentence.
flags.orchard.june_tree_out: June Harrow's failing tree was taken out in the second life.
flags.orchard.june_tree_kept: June's tree was kept though it spoils the row.
flags.orchard.sold_south: The south block was sold for houses.
flags.orchard.nell_keeps: Nell keeps the trees as heir, not as a lawsuit.
flags.orchard.asa_stops: Asa ends the grafting of new lives onto the old row.
flags.bridge.testimony_given: Ellis put Bram's pencil ticks into a spoken record. The pier was jacketed.
flags.bridge.testimony_withheld: Ellis kept the landing's season. The pier was not forced.
flags.bridge.unresolved: The pencil was seen or the season broke before testimony.
flags.bridge.pier_read: Someone in Ellis's will has read the ticks in the concrete.
flags.bridge.bram_named: Bram's name was said on the abutment before any other business.
flags.bridge.plaque_true: The plaque names the painter and not the comfort.
flags.bridge.plaque_comfort: The plaque names the contractor and a soft version of the rest.
flags.bridge.plaque_blank: No sentence was supplied. The plaque is blank or bureaucratic.
flags.bridge.warned_2008: In 2008 Ellis said the piers were dusting, in time for the warning to be a choice.
flags.bridge.season_protected: In 2008 Ellis kept the summer's traffic unfrightened.
flags.bridge.promise_sentence: In 2022 the promise was named as the sentence, not the steel.
flags.bridge.promise_span: In 2022 the promise was named as the span that carries cars.
flags.mill.downstream_told: The downstream farms were told the night wheel was stealing their morning.
flags.mill.counsel_kept: Ellis kept the mill's counsel. The wheel stayed a family fact.
flags.mill.unresolved: The night wheel was seen and not answered.
flags.mill.eli_left: Eli Demerritt left the wheel because the truth was said out loud.
flags.mill.gate_repinned: Ansel repinned the gate to pass more water. He will not let Ellis touch it.
flags.mill.told_late: In 1966 Ellis broke the mill's counsel after fourteen years. It does not rewrite Eli's 1953 leaving; it only makes the secret late and public.
flags.mill.ada_kept: Ada's mouth kept Ansel's counsel a second time.
flags.floodbook.margin_kept: The official book keeps both the certification and Ivo's margin.
flags.floodbook.fair_copy: A fair copy exists with the margin cleaned out.

flags.floodbook.wet_saved_margin: After the thaw, the margin was the part that dried readable.

flags.floodbook.precedent_refused: Ellis refused to let the flood book justify a new gate.
flags.floodbook.precedent_used: The flood book was used as a precedent.
flags.floodbook.signed_voice: Ellis signed the Voice's account in a living hand.
flags.floodbook.signed_other: Ellis signed the Other Voice's account in a living hand.
flags.floodbook.signed_both: Ellis wrote both accounts and signed neither as sole.
flags.floodbook.signed_neither: The sentence was left unfinished on purpose.

flags.floodbook.single_book: Ellis refused a second copy. One flood book was carried, and the shed was not given a page.
flags.household.ate: Ellis ate the plate set for the displaced life.
flags.household.left_plate: Ellis left the plate. The house keeps two lives.

flags.household.true_want: Ellis gave the household one true want the body had, which Ellis will not perform.
flags.household.slept_east: Ellis slept in the east-room bed.
flags.household.sat_up: Ellis sat the night without using the bed.
flags.household.book_to_office: The household book of names was given to the survey office.
flags.household.book_stays: The book of names stays in the house, out of the office.
flags.household.names_released: The names were spoken once at the creek and not kept.
flags.household.room_rented: The east room was rented to a living neighbor.
flags.letters.one_delivered: One unsent letter was delivered by hand.
flags.letters.burned: The unsent letters were burned as a mercy.
flags.letters.sung: The unsent letters were sung as a roll of names.
flags.letters.answered_as_ellis: A letter to a displaced life was answered in Ellis's will, not the body's.
flags.letters.archived: The letters became a public holding.
flags.letters.kept_choir: The letters stayed a private choir.
flags.creemee.name_as_spoken: The order book records the misheard name as spoken.

flags.creemee.recipe_labeled: A dairy label owns the flavor name.
flags.creemee.word_stays: Pearl kept the word creemee as a place, not a product.
flags.creemee.word_leaves: The word was allowed onto a truck that leaves the county.
flags.creemee.warned: The stand was turned toward a book of names before the bridge closure.
flags.creemee.till_full: The last busy summer was protected. The book was not copied.
flags.creemee.closed_kept: The stand is closed and the order book is kept.
flags.creemee.window_rite: Once a year the window opens.
flags.quarry.names_spoken: The chalked names were spoken at supper.

flags.quarry.unrealized_left: An unrealized name was left on the wall.

flags.quarry.stone_choice: Ellis chose which twelve names the state would cut.
flags.quarry.oral_only: Gina and Ellis left the names oral.
flags.animal.whistled: Ellis let the body do Ivo's whistle.
flags.animal.moved: Queen was moved off her log.

flags.animal.band_cut: A band was cut off Queen.
flags.animal.band_left: A band was left on Queen.
flags.animal.story_county: Queen's story was told as county fact.
flags.animal.story_family: Queen's story was told as Pike family fact.
flags.cistern.drunk: Ellis drank from the cistern and said the taste.
flags.cistern.spooned: A spoon of silt was taken toward the survey record.
flags.boots.returned: Ivo's boots were returned to Helen Perch.
flags.milk.hours_changed: The night wheel's hours were put into the meadow's mouth.
flags.milk.farmer_blamed: Henry March was left thinking his own cooling was the failure.
flags.lambing.vet_to_upper: The vet went to the upper barn.
flags.lambing.vet_to_lower: The vet went to the lower barn.
flags.hired.name_stripped: Evan Dunn was made to stop wearing a dead cutter's name.
flags.hired.name_kept: The borrowed name was left in use.

flags.crossing.unlogged: An untolled crossing was left out of the log.
flags.crossing.night_closed: The landing was closed for the night.
flags.ice.warned: Ellis said the ice was unsafe.
flags.ice.shrugged: Ellis would not judge the ice.
flags.bell.stopped: The Larabee bell was stopped for the dead.
flags.bell.joined: Ellis rang the bell with Tom Yorston.
flags.bell.moved: The bell was moved off the landing.
flags.apples.bill_destroyed: The bill of sale on the apple crate was destroyed.
flags.apples.bill_honored: The bill of sale was honored.
flags.apples.bill_to_nell: The bill was taken to Nell unhonored and undestroyed.
flags.marble.water_to_tenant: The race hour was given to Agnes Holt's floor.
flags.marble.water_to_wheel: The race hour stayed with the wheel.
flags.eel.head_kept: The head of water was kept.
flags.soup.kitchen: Ellis ate in Marie Rouleau's kitchen during the wage fight.
flags.soup.upstairs: Ellis ate upstairs with the office.
flags.clark.signed: Ellis re-signed a clean certification for Clark Seaver.
flags.dust.posted: Marble-dust counts were posted at the cut.
flags.dust.handed: Dust counts were handed to workers and not posted.
flags.powder.returned: The powder-shack key was returned unusable to Vito.
flags.core.safe_face: The geologist was sent to a face that is not a name-wall.
flags.core.allowed: The name-face was allowed to be cored.
flags.envelopes.memorial: Blank wage envelopes were kept as memorial.
flags.envelopes.fraud_stopped: The envelopes were stopped as fraud.
flags.slide.bus_first: The school-bus road was cleared first.
flags.slide.quarry_first: The quarry lane was cleared first.
flags.grace.flinched: Ellis flinched at the wrong name in the grace.
flags.grace.held: Ellis held still through the wrong name.
flags.grange.sheltered: Nan Pettis stayed the storm in the grange.
flags.grange.turned_out: Nan Pettis was turned out before the feed.
flags.post.rule_bent: Walter bent the rule and let the dead letter be claimed.
flags.hymn.used_line: Gail's unsent line was sung at her burial.
flags.ink.wrote_cert: In the cold, Ellis wrote the certification sentence.
flags.ink.wrote_margin: In the cold, Ellis wrote the margin sentence.
flags.ink.wrote_neither: Ellis wrote neither sentence the voices offered.
flags.inspect.open: The stand stayed open past the inspection.
flags.window.opened: Ivy opened the boarded window for one night.
flags.recipe.paid_kitty: Kitty March was paid the recipe's wage in public attribution and a season's cream, not in a craft.
flags.recipe.pearl_kept: Pearl kept the recipe as stand property.
flags.bench.stayed: The bench stayed in the right-of-way by a spoken refusal.
flags.till.left: The wrapper stayed in the till unopened.
flags.band.withdrawn: Lula withdrew her name from the banding permit.
flags.band.left_on_permit: Lula's name stayed on the permit.
flags.stake.corrected: The Dead Creek boundary stake was corrected.
flags.stake.left_wrong: The wrong stake was left so the flood book would still be believed.
flags.heron.revealed: The heronry was revealed to stop a pullout.
flags.heron.traffic_truth: Ellis gave the bridge-traffic truth instead of the birds.
flags.cow.kept: The March cow was not butchered.
flags.dog.logged: Cal wrote the dog into the landing log as a witness.
flags.garden.corrected: Sadie Burnham's ten feet were corrected.

flags.grave.line_moves: The town line was allowed to move the Abbott grave on paper.

flags.helen.confronted: Helen was confronted with the margin that names her.

flags.helen.asked_gordon: Gordon was asked instead of Helen.

flags.wages.day_saved: The wet wage book saved the day crew's numbers.
flags.copy.given: Willa's private contradictory copy was given to a stranger.
flags.slate.school: Cress's slate went to the school as a penmanship lesson.
flags.slate.house: The slate went back to the Quiet Household.
flags.clock.wound: Joel wound Harold's clock past the stopped minute.
flags.meal.cooked_wrong: Ellis cooked the meal wrong so the body would not be comforted.
flags.coat.today: The basin coat was treated as today's loss.
flags.coat.old_wound: The basin coat was forced into the 1938 story.
flags.sugar.fixed: The sugarhouse acres were fixed. The homestead pays.
flags.sugar.left: The wrong acres were left. The tax stays kind.

flags.mail.all: All the unopened body-letters were opened.

flags.drill.paper_wins: Where drill log and chalk disagree, the paper was treated as true.

flags.son_letter.read_at_grave: The hidden letter was read where Bram could not answer.
